# Eventzilla

Eventzilla is an event management platform that provides tools for creating, promoting, and managing events, including ticketing, registration, and attendee management.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/eventzilla/.

## Actions

- **Get User Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information of a specific user.
- **List Event Categories** (read-only): Retrieve event categories available in eventzilla.
- **List Events** (read-only): Retrieve a list of events associated with your account (supports filtering).
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of users associated with your account.
